item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-f0ffc18dbe08506b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"During a parliamentary discussion in April 2023, Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Huq, invoking Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's role in placing the motion, called for a new law allowing legal action against people who allegedly lied about or opposed the Liberation War and independence, and said such legislation should be enacted to punish anti-state and anti-independence elements.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.5","3B.8","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns government policy advocacy and parliamentary action in April 2023, within the 2023-2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the proposal to the minister; it states that Sheikh Hasina placed the motion but does not state that she personally endorsed the proposed punitive law.","limitations":["Evidence concerns a ministerial proposal and parliamentary context, not a completed law or a direct personal statement by Hasina."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a2af73a45297ad2d","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 4 June 2023, Sheikh Hasina stated that her government and the Awami League were firmly committed to implementing the Tk 7,61,785-crore FY2023-24 national budget and would be able to do so; she also criticized budget critics as spreading discouraging statements and speaking against Bangladesh before foreigners.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","7B.1","7B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct statement and announced budget concern from June 2023, within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributed to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The document reports an implementation commitment but provides no executed-budget data, independent evaluation, or outcome evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-52e3ad020a02932b","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 29 July 2023, police used tear gas and rubber bullets to disperse protesters blockading roads in Dhaka; clashes involved stone-throwing crowds, at least six hospitalized protesters, and the detention of senior BNP figures. The report states that at least 500 opposition activists had been arrested before a BNP rally that week, and describes broader allegations of mass detention, extrajudicial killings, disappearances, and authoritarian political conditions under Hasina's government.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9","6B.7","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reports protest policing, opposition arrests, and political conditions during July 2023, within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes police action and the broader governing context to Hasina's government; allegations of extrajudicial killings and disappearances are presented as accusations by reporting sources and security-force critics.","limitations":["The account includes violence by protesters and reports allegations rather than adjudicated findings for the broader claims; it does not establish Hasina's personal order for each action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-31193995bc83ab2f","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, President Mohammed Shahabuddin praised Sheikh Hasina for overcoming alleged conspiracies and completing the self-financed Padma Bridge, describing her leadership as honest, dedicated, patriotic, uncompromising, and farsighted; the report states that Shahabuddin had previously served as an ACC commissioner involved in addressing the project's alleged corruption controversy.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","7B.1","7B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Contemporary April 2023 praise of a project completed before the period, relevant as reported background to Hasina's 2023 program and institutional legacy.","ruler_attribution":"The positive assessments are President Shahabuddin's statements, not independent findings in the document.","limitations":["The article is laudatory and provides no independent cost, audit, procurement, or outcome verification; the project largely predates 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0e07bbd9415710f0","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In a May 2023 message, Sheikh Hasina reaffirmed Bangladesh's commitment to global peacekeeping and peacebuilding, highlighted Bangladesh as one of the largest UN peacekeeper contributors, supported women's participation and protection in peacekeeping, and said the Awami League government would continue efforts enabling Bangladeshi personnel to respond to UN calls.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.7","1B.10","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct statement and government commitment issued in May 2023, within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributed to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in an official BSS report.","limitations":["The document describes rhetoric and an established peacekeeping role but does not provide mission-level compliance, safeguards, funding, or outcome verification for 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-72d063062d398dee","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, Bangladesh received its first Russian uranium shipment for the Rooppur nuclear power plant. The $12.65 billion project was 90% financed by a Russian loan repayable over 28 years with a 10-year grace period; construction had been delayed by COVID-19 restrictions and sanctions related to the Ukraine conflict, and Bangladesh had denied entry to a Russian equipment ship in December because of sanctions.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.7","1B.8","1B.10","5B.3","5B.9","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports the October 2023 fuel delivery and project financing, with some delays and prior decisions described as background.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina is directly quoted describing the delivery as a source of national pride; project financing and delay facts are attributed to Reuters' reporting.","limitations":["The document does not establish Hasina's personal role in technical safety, command-and-control, safeguards, or loan repayment decisions; it reports no accident or proliferation event."]},{"source_id":"SRC-234d3b48833803d5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"At the October 2023 Rooppur fuel ceremony, Bangladesh received its first nuclear fuel shipment, with Sheikh Hasina participating alongside Vladimir Putin. The IAEA director-general said Bangladesh was implementing the plant according to IAEA guidelines and international safety and security rules; the project had trained 1,000 Bangladeshi engineers, established a training centre, planned Russian fuel supply for the first three years, and required Russia to take back spent fuel. Construction was reported at about 90% for unit one and 70% for unit two.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.6","1B.7","1B.10","5B.6","5B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"All reported milestones, safeguards statements, training, and fuel arrangements concern the October 2023 project status.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina's participation and support are directly reported; the safety assessment is attributed to the IAEA director-general, and operational arrangements to project officials and Rosatom representatives.","limitations":["The document reports planned or asserted safeguards and progress, not independent inspection records or evidence of actual operational performance; the plant was not yet operating."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-cf4c7ae1c3195c54","SRC-423da04ee9f8bd48","SRC-3e135a8c55bf2286","SRC-93cea20d62f65ff1","SRC-b035e3309288782d"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents contain only webpage navigation or material outside the 2023-2023 target period.","The evidence set contains no direct material on some nuclear-risk, economic, social-welfare, or personal-integrity questions; absence of a fact is not evidence of absence."]}
